evidenceScope.renderer: Robolectric Android Views Bitmap Canvas, as implemented in the exact-source tests
evidenceScope.nativeBuildMode: Host rendering and JUnit result inspection; no emulator or physical-device operation performed by reviewer

criteria.criterion: Visible phone labels, actions, cards and status remain readable
Visible320px/font2 content wraps without overlapping or clipped action labels
Worker screen retains explicit location-off and privacy language
Physical install, actual touch/keyboard navigation, TalkBack, GPS hardware and live company journeys

findings.finding: The first phone metric card is17px shorter than the other two when its label occupies one line.
findings.recommendation: Align heights within a shared metric row using its measured content height; retain the stacked layout and unrestricted text growth at large fonts.

nonBlockingObservations: The long enrollment field hint is horizontally clipped in phone-shift.png, but the separate visible label is complete. This is a single-line input hint, not a clipped action or missing accessible label.

Some synthetic names and original message bodies remain German/English when the interface is Ukrainian. The visible demo label makes this data scope explicit; this review does not assess complete business-content translation.

Initial large-font screenshots show only the top of each scrollable screen. Below-fold control reachability is supported by source scroll containers and host control-width/height/label checks, not by physical swipes or keyboard interaction.

junitObserved.testSourceNotes: Exact-source screenshot helpers measure/layout/draw Views on a Bitmap Canvas. assertControlBounds checks width>0 and<=viewport, minimum48px target, and no ellipsized/overwide button text. It is not an emulator, physical interaction or screen-reader test.
